description: Run the daily workstream update workflow for the Obsidian vault. Generates today's workstream summary from meeting summaries, syncs individual workstream files, copies daily-note entries into workstream files, updates PROJECT_DECISIONS.md, ACTION_ITEMS.guilherme_bencke.md, and the Decisions tables in all Topics subtopic files, then publishes to git. Use when asked to "run daily workstream update", "generate daily summary", "sync workstreams", "update workstream files", or invokes /daily-workstream-update.
